format: One JSON object per line in texts.jsonl
sourceFile: Byte-exact preserved XML. Look up inventory.json by file for original path and SHA-256.

scopeRules.generic: Exact short-label allowlist: Allow, Back, Cancel, Close, Delete, Deny, Done, Exit, Help, Next, OK, Retry, Save, Search, Settings, Sign in, 下一步, 保存, 允许, 关闭, 删除, 取消, 完成, 帮助, 拒绝, 搜索, 登录, 确定, 确认, 设置, 返回, 退出, 重试
scopeRules.health: Explicit health-domain term matched by the documented build script; analyst classification, not author intent.
scopeRules.unknown: No reviewed classification; preserve context-dependent copy.

limitations: Copying a string does not approve its meaning for another product.
The JSON index is a lookup representation. Original XML is authoritative for spans, placeholders, escaping, attributes and quantity rules.
Most resource text ownership and SDK provenance are unknown; do not infer first-party authorship from name prefixes.
